name: Fold
description: A wavefolder insert for a track: a triangle fold with a level-compensated drive (Fold, in dB: the signal folds back from 1/Fold of full scale, so the fold never raises the level), a Symmetry offset that folds one side first, a one-pole Tone low-pass that tames the aliasing, an always-on DC blocker, a dry/wet mix and an output level, with a view of the transfer curve. One mono instance.
